svg.title: Red Curve
svg.desc: Interpretive study after an actually inspected primary reference. Geometry and interpretive screen colour approximate. Red sector-shaped support identified at left in the Barnes installation. Two straight lower edges meet at a low point beneath a broad convex upper arc. Approximate outline only; painted support separated from the wall. Foundation photograph explicitly labels this title and EK identifier; medium classification remains as sourced. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for red; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://ellsworthkelly.org/exhibition/ellsworth-kelly-sculpture-on-the-wall/; catalogue record foundation-exhib-v4-ek746-ellsworth-kelly-sculpture-on-the-wall; inspected2026-10-27. Pure editable vector study, not photographic facsimile.
